reply_to.description: For a comment: the id of the post or comment it answers. For an update: the id of your own post. Otherwise empty, without brackets.

title.description: For a post: its title. Otherwise empty.

body.description: For a post, comment or update: its text. Otherwise empty.

upvote.description: Ids of posts or comments by other members that you upvote, without brackets. May be empty.
